study.name: Retest: Phase 3a Replication: Thinking Level at T=0.7 N=30
study.description:
Replication of the Phase 3a consensus voting experiment with properly
controlled thinking levels. The original Phase 3a runs labelled as
"HIGH" and "minimal" both used thinking_level=minimal in their configs.
This replication creates a clean comparison.

Also tests for model drift: if the minimal replication departs from
the historical F1 range [0.683, 0.751], the gemini-3-flash-preview
model has changed since February 2026.
study.retest_notes: Thinking level replication (minimal vs HIGH). K=30 at T=0.7.
